result.title: AD-SRF: Attack-Defense Semantic Reinforcement for Multi-Modal Image Fusion
result.summary: Existing image fusion methods struggle to balance visual quality and semantic attributes due to the inherent conflict between their optimization objectives. To address this challenge, we propose an attack-defense semantic reinforcement framework for multi-modal image fusion, termed AD-SRF. By decoupling the optimization of these two aspects and then losslessly reintegrating them, this framework injects rich semantic attributes into the fused image without compromising its visual quality. First, we develop a transformer-based restorative visual fusion network as a strong visual baseline. Equipped with the cross-modal retrieval module and the information restoration-fusion collaborative loss, it produces highly visible fused images even under degraded conditions. Second, we introduce an attack-defense game mechanism to strengthen the semantic attributes of the fused images. The attacker learns perturbation patterns that impair downstream segmentation, whereas the defender restores missing semantics from the original inputs and reintegrates them into the fused image through an imperceptible semantic map. Through iterative adversarial interaction, this mechanism drives the defender to continually strengthen the fused image's semantic attributes, boosting downstream segmentation performance without compromising visual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AD-SRF achieves a win-win performance in both visual quality and semantic attributes. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaoZhang1018/AD-SRF.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AD-SRF 攻击—防御语义强化框架，用于多模态图像融合：以 transformer 融合网络加跨模态检索模块与协作损失保证视觉质量，再用攻击者—防御者博弈把缺失语义以不可见语义图注入融合图像，以提升下游分割且不损画质。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以对抗扰动探测任务语义是否被破坏、再回注缺失语义」的博弈机制，可能为检验 LVR 内部状态是否保留并使用任务必要视觉信息、以及语义旁路与信息坍缩诊断提供线索，可供核查，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。
